about: What each r/unixporn screenshot shows about its terminals, looked at once. Facts only; screenshots are linked from the dataset, never stored here.

entries.note: Cream Gruvbox-light windows with thin borders sit on a loud comic wallpaper; the paper-like palette stays consistent across fetch, news, music and files, though GUI Emacs and a PDF reader share it.
Near-black windows with Catppuccin mauve accents harmonise with the lilac dusk wallpaper; a large neovim and a compact fetch are readable, with a launcher overlapping the editor.
A full-screen Neovim with file tree, LSP popup and minimap, faintly showing the moody wallpaper behind. A teal accent runs through the status line and code; clean and legible.
No terminal in the shot: a moon wallpaper, an app launcher and a power menu only.
A clean Gruvbox-dark three-way split: a tall editor with a completion popup, a framed fetch and a cream cava chart. One orange border marks focus; palette and spacing are very disciplined.
Collage of a grey desktop where black rounded windows pop against a light background; tiny fetch and cava tiles are crisp, with a clean vim config as the largest terminal.
Collage of one Carbonfox setup with translucent floating windows (fetch, tty-clock, nvim, htop, ranger) in cool blue tones; consistent and tidy, text is small in the tall image.
Tokyo Night palette is used consistently; rounded tiled windows sit beside a notes app, and neovim with an in-editor fetch reads cleanly with good padding.
Fetch, ncmpcpp with visualizer and neovim sit in clean dark tiles with a blue accent; the other three screens are GUI apps.
Only anime artwork and a top bar are shown; no terminal is visible.
Photo of a laptop mounted on a wall: three bordered tiles (spotify TUI, cava, fetch) in cyan over a blue wallpaper look neat, but the photo and angle make the text unreadable.
Overlapping floating windows (khal, file list, IRC chat, cava) in soft Catppuccin tones with thin rounded borders; a Spotify client takes up space in the same collage.
A single navy fetch window with a thin blue border sits over the anime wallpaper; photo of a laptop screen with glare, so the text is only just legible.
Three tiled translucent windows with matching teal-blue tones: dashboard, fetch and matrix rain. Clean layout, though the glass blur leaves the dim text a bit low-contrast.
Translucent blue-tinted panes (editor, htop, ncmpcpp, cava, ranger, fetch) sit on a starry night wallpaper; coherent cool palette, but the collage is small and text gets faint.
Cream terminals with thick dark borders on sage green, same palette in the browser start page and launcher; very consistent, but the small light-on-light text is faint.
Gruvbox-style amber on near-black with a faint wallpaper showing through; the vim status line and orange fetch logo share one palette, but the tall right terminal is mostly empty.
Terminal is secondary here: one fetch window half hidden behind apps, plus a VS Code panel. Powerline prompt and tmux bar are tidy but small.
Four wallpapers, each with small dark floating terminals (fetch, cava, music, files, editor). Muted dark panels sit softly on the art and stay consistent across themes.
Catppuccin lavender on near-black: fetch with a photo beside it, then a roomy neovim with file tree, completion popup and a tidy status line. Consistent palette, good padding.
Cohesive navy palette with small floating windows with soft shadows; the text is tiny and low-contrast at this scale, though the ncmpcpp and cava pair is tidy.
Translucent dark panes pick up the pink-coral geometric wallpaper, so the rose accent in neovim, cava and btop matches the bar and clock widgets. Small editor text is dim on the busy backdrop.
Cream paper background with rust, teal and brown ink: a disciplined retro palette across fetch, ranger, vim, btop and cava. Light terminals are rare and this one holds together.
One Catppuccin Alacritty with a fetch and a two-line prompt sits among a music app, VS Code, Blender and a conky panel; the pastel theme is consistent but the terminal is small.
A solid gruvbox-dark window with a yellow ASCII logo and tidy, large fetch text beside a game window; readable and warm. The big empty gap above the prompt wastes space.
Tokyo Night wezterm split into btop and a music player, sitting next to a chat app over a neon city. Text is tiny at this scale, but the dark blue palette fits the wallpaper.
Soft purple frosted windows with a cat sticker in the fetch and a music player with lyrics; colors pull from the flower wallpaper. Text sits a little low-contrast on the glass.
Photo of a handheld device showing an amber-tinted image and a status bar; no readable terminal text or prompt is visible.
One big near-black window with a fetch block whose tan swatches echo the warm wooden-pier wallpaper. Restrained and readable, though the oversized window leaves lots of empty space.
Flat black boxes with cream text float over a photo, leaving it clear. Very restrained palette, though the plain black slabs look stark and the right box is just repeated filler text.
A screen capture of a recording app nested inside itself; no terminal window is visible.
A moon wallpaper with a bar and a notification card. No readable terminal is visible, only a faint ghost window.
Strict two-color palette (brick red and orange) carries the whole screen; big type and padding make the vim completion popup and shell very legible.
The image renders as solid black; no terminal or any content is visible.
An anime wallpaper with a yellow menu, clock and music widget; no terminal window is visible.
No terminal anywhere: a pink anime wallpaper with shell widgets (weather, calendar, to-do, palette) and side docks.
Two flat deep-blue boxes stacked with a gap and pulled from the pixel-art wallpaper palette; soft pastel text, even padding and a tiny prompt make it cute and legible.
A login greeter card over a blurred gradient; no terminal in the picture.
Three plum-black tiles with warm orange text echo the red-orange wallpaper. Strong palette discipline and clear gaps; the text rain tile adds drama without hurting legibility.
Classic four-tile dashboard (fetch, music, clock, cava) with a teal and coral palette over a dimmed wallpaper; even gutters and consistent translucency make it feel finished.
A large centered iTerm window with neovim in One Dark colors and a gradient banner tile over a blurred pastel wallpaper; generous padding and calm, readable colors.
Two small overlapping dark windows, a cyan and pink visualizer over a track list; tidy and legible, but dwarfed by the big widgets and start page around them.
One dark teal Konsole centered on a pastel wallpaper, with a colored powerline prompt and a matching tmux status bar; clean contrast, but the window is empty.
Translucent fetch window sits well over the artwork, but low-contrast grey text and small size get lost among the conky panels and file manager.
Three st windows (htop tree, fetch, ranger) fill the screen edge to edge; dark charcoal with one orange accent and an orange focus border, tight and consistent, almost no padding.
A big mint tty-clock above an empty shell, both smoked glass over a low-poly wallpaper. Bold pixel digits give a clear focal point; the tall shell below is mostly empty.
Pywal-themed tiling of ranger, screenfetch and cmatrix in violet with cyan highlights, matching the mountain wallpaper; tidy gaps. Other parts of the collage are wallpaper and a browser.
A blurred translucent htop in a tmux session shares the screen with a code editor and a docs browser; the terminal is readable but secondary to the GUI windows.
Single turquoise accent on near-black translucent tiles over a teal anime wallpaper: gotop, ranger, a dotted visualizer and fetch. Tight palette discipline and strong thin borders.
Four equal tiles with even gaps over a purple gradient; one rose accent colors clock, fetch and cava while cmatrix stays dim. Clean grid, strong palette discipline.
Purple tiles with orange syntax, cava bars and matrix rain match the sunset wallpaper; the whole set reads as one palette. Vim text is small but legible.
Smoked teal panels scattered over a moody wallpaper, each with one job (music, mail and chat, cava, color scripts). Muted purple accents hold the palette together; text is small.
Two translucent vim windows show the red mountain wallpaper through dark glass; gruvbox yellow and green code stays readable. A conky panel and clock fill the rest of the desktop.
A large blurred translucent terminal with plain package-manager output next to a code editor; the blur keeps the text readable but there is little visual design to the terminal itself.
Four tiled translucent windows (man page, gdb, two vim) tinted by a red sunset wallpaper; the moody gradient looks great but small, dim text gets hard to read where the red is strongest.
Three freely placed flat-dark windows with soft shadows over a warm illustrated wallpaper; cyan fetch text and syntax colors pop, good contrast and generous padding.
Seven frosted tiles (palette, clock, fetch, ranger, cava, lists) in one icy blue-grey palette; tidy grid with even gaps, and the lower half switches to GUI editor and PDF.
Cream cowsay terminal matches the startpage and widgets; small and palette-consistent, but one of many equal-weight panels.
A single translucent Konsole with a neon green ASCII fetch and a powerline prompt matches the magenta sunset, but it is one small window among a browser, video and file manager.
A smoked-glass fetch window with the angry-face image matches the wallpaper character; a joke that works, though the text is small and low contrast against the orange sky.
Music list, cava bars and a split vim/ranger window in matching teal and purple on a blue-gray ground with titled frames. Very coherent palette; roomy padding.
Violet border and labels echo the wallpaper, and the ufetch block is readable; the full-screen code view is Emacs, which is not counted as a terminal here.
Four equal tiles in a sage-green and charcoal palette with one orange accent: fetch, dot-matrix clock, a photo in the terminal and a dialog form; tidy grid, big readable type.
Navy windows with one hot pink-red accent in vim, the music list and the clock read as one set; syntax colors stay disciplined and the big clock is a strong focal point.
Borderless transparent terminals sit straight on a flat slate desktop, so text reads like part of the wallpaper; very clean and calm, with muted pink and green accents.
Gruvbox throughout: a five-tile wall of ranger, nano, vim, htop and pipes plus a fetch. Palette discipline is excellent, though the text is tiny; other parts are GUI apps.
Three frosted tiles over a blurred wallpaper: nano, cyan neofetch and a blue cava. Blur keeps text legible; cyan and agnoster chips repeat across panes. Plain gray nano is the dull one.
Full Nord wall: ranger, ncmpcpp, nano, vim with tree, shell and a big cava, all slate blue on translucent dark. Strict palette and tidy gaps; the text is small but consistent.
Navy fetch with an inline image and a red-bordered file tree, both with a kaomoji prompt; clean, but a game window takes most of the screen.
One translucent Konsole split into fetch, green matrix rain and vim over a blurred sky; the see-through look is pretty, though the vim splash text nearly disappears into the background.
One dark Konsole with a large red Ubuntu logo fetch over a mountain wallpaper; the red contrasts well and the type is large. The rest of the shot is file manager, editor and a dock.
Clean iTerm2 window with a tab bar and cpu/net graphs, matched to the dark browser; very empty, so the prompt is the only content.
One full-screen translucent plum terminal showing a large orange and blue powerline prompt with git branch; big, readable text and a limited warm palette, though mostly empty space.
Two dark floating windows with crimson powerline status chips and red fetch labels, matching the red-and-blue robot wallpaper and the widget sidebar. Strong palette; vim text is a bit small.
Terminator split into fetch with a powerline prompt over vim; translucency suits the wallpaper, but the IDE beside it takes most of the attention.
No terminal: pastel pink and purple desktop with a sidebar widget, a file manager and an image viewer.
Three translucent tiles over a colorful wallpaper with a cyan accent from the visualizer; readable, but the busy art behind the text hurts contrast.
Orange-on-plum palette is lifted from the wallpaper; three bordered windows with even gaps and powerline status lines read as one set. Dense text stays legible.
Olive and salmon translucent boxes (gotop, htop, fetch, small prompts) over a blurred game scene; harmonious and low contrast, thin text gets faint where the wallpaper is bright.
Two smoked-glass windows, a cyan cava and an ncmpcpp playlist, sit over a blurred beach photo; the cyan bars pop but the rest is mostly GUI panels.
Empty KDE desktop with only a wallpaper and a top panel; no terminal.
Frosted translucent windows over a sunny macro-flower wallpaper: vim, ncmpcpp, cava and pipes each have one job, with cyan bars and neon pipes popping; text is slightly thin on the bright blur.
A wall of five tiled terminals in one violet-on-black palette matching the wallpaper and widgets. Very dense; the ranger, mail and vim text is tiny but consistent.
A photo of a physical desk: a tiled dark terminal screen and a laptop with a fetch. Text is unreadable at photo scale; the point is the all-terminal workstation.
Cava, editor, file manager and fetch tiled over a glitchy magenta wallpaper; red and pink prompts match, a Spotify window takes the last slot.
Only a rofi launcher and bars over a gradient; no terminal is visible.
Two stacked blurred urxvt windows (ranger, fetch with ascii art) tiled beside Firefox; the red wallpaper glow gives a coherent accent, and text on the dark glass stays readable.
Strict Nord palette: colored window borders, matching fetch swatches and htop header, all in one cool blue-gray family. Consistent and calm; text is dense but readable.
Translucent green-tinted terminals pick up the wallpaper colors so they blend in; the comments in the editor get washed out against the busy background.
Three dark glass tiles tinted to the outrun wallpaper; cyan text and one clock keep it tidy and readable.
Two flat charcoal TUI windows, ranger and a music list, are tiled edge to edge over a dark ink-and-red wallpaper. Strict grey palette; readable but plain and a bit dense.
Four desktops of tiled dark terminals running vim, ranger, cava, mail, chat and fetch; very consistent blue-on-dark palette, dense but each tile has one clear job.
Crimson text on a see-through window with a thin border; palette matches the wallpaper exactly, though the small red text on dark purple is dim.
One tall st window with vim, dark charcoal with a warm orange status line, set against a teal wallpaper; comfortable line spacing and strong contrast, split-screen with the picture.
A small dark fetch tile with teal labels and a row of colored triangles sits in the corner; tidy, but it is dwarfed by the file manager and menus over a loud wallpaper.
A single fetch window with mint accents and a blue prompt chip, set beside a code editor. Good contrast and padding, but only one terminal in a busy desktop.
A pale card-like music panel with pink visualizer bars matches the purple gradient desktop; unclear whether it is a terminal (no prompt), the rest is GUI apps and a login screen.
Two full-height green-tinted windows tiled under a camo border: an IRC client and ranger with image preview. Strong theme, large readable text, but a modal dialog covers the middle.
Maroon-tinted translucent windows match the red-and-orange sunset art; ncmpcpp, cava, vim and fetch all share one palette, though translucency lowers contrast on small text.
Charcoal windows with beige text over a blurred grey photo; vim, cava, ncmpcpp and lf share one muted palette, but the text is small and low contrast.
Two stacked charcoal terminals on a flat red-orange wallpaper; salmon labels and the swatch strip echo the picture, with a large empty shell pane below the fetch.
Muted slate windows with soft blue borders sit over a desaturated sea wallpaper; the overlapping vim and fetch windows are calm and readable, with a pastel color strip.
Four translucent tiles over a black-and-white illustration: fetch, palette, spotify TUI, config. Strict grayscale makes it cohesive; the text over the art is slightly busy.
Near-black terminals pop against a lime-to-olive gradient. A tall editor and a small fetch are framed with an anime picture and a widget; high contrast, generous padding.
Two black terminals with orange text pull their color straight from the wallpaper; a strict two-color palette and drop shadows make it striking, though the small text is dense.
Tmux-style window stacking a music list, a cyan visualizer strip and a nano buffer over a blurred wallpaper; nicely layered, though the text is dense and small.
Four translucent windows (gotop, matrix rain, fetch with image, ranger) tile the screen over a glitchy city wallpaper; nicely uniform, but the thin text is dim over the busy background.
Full-screen vim with a gruvbox palette beside a PDF note viewer; the wallpaper shows through lightly. Clean and readable, but the editor is cropped to a half-width tile.
Five tinted translucent tiles (editor, fetch, matrix, cava, prompt) form a dashboard whose teal accents match the wallpaper; text over the glass is sometimes low contrast.
One small fetch window shown in a dark and a pastel pink theme. It is dwarfed by the chat and music apps, but the colors follow the wallpaper well.
Collage with a browser and image viewer on the light-blue wallpaper plus a dark five-window tiled terminal workspace; text is tiny and low contrast, so the windows read as dark blocks.
Strict two-tone palette pulled from the acid-yellow wallpaper; rounded windows with a music player and a big ASCII fetch keep the theme consistent and readable.
Navy windows with pywal blue text over a vivid sunset sky; cowsay, fetch, Vim and ncmpcpp with a waveform visualizer. Cohesive, though the last screen is a bright web browser.
Three flat charcoal bspwm tiles (neovim, ufetch, salmon cava) over a black-and-white space wallpaper; salmon accent repeats everywhere. Simple, high contrast, easy on the eyes.
Three near-black boxes (htop, fetch, a big pixel clock) on a photo, all in one mint green accent; simple and readable, though the clock block sits heavy over the road.
Four dark windows with soft shadows and one pink-bordered focus window on a flat grey desktop; a big gradient figlet banner and a Hue TUI give variety, one pink accent keeps it tidy.
Six faint glass windows over a blurred mountain, tiny text in muted blue-grey. Cohesive and calm, but the low contrast and small type make it hard to read.
Tiled translucent terminals let the line-art wallpaper show through; thin text and low-contrast monitor panels are faint, but the grey and olive palette is consistent.
Light off-white windows over pale paper wallpaper, with red as the only accent in prompt chips, line numbers and the fetch logo. Clean, high-contrast and very disciplined.
Purple on deep indigo throughout; full-screen nvim with splits, ranger with an image preview and gotop are consistent and dense, with a purple-bordered window frame.
Nord blue-grey terminals that match the forest wallpaper: a fetch card with a character image, a full-height editor and a bordered system monitor. Well padded and calm.
Dark navy windows with cyan highlights match the teal sci-fi wallpaper exactly; a clear four-tile layout (file manager, music, menu, cava) plus a big vim with splits. Strong palette discipline.
Full-width lf over neovim with a small fetch floating on top, in muted gruvbox-like tones; dense and readable, with the painting below.
Dark translucent panes with soft pink-gray text over a muted city photo: a tall script editor, fetch and a music pane. Pleasant mood, but the faint text lowers readability.
Nord slate windows floating over a soft pink-lilac mountain wallpaper; muted pastel fetch swatches match it. Cohesive and calm, though the windows are small and overlap.
Nord slate windows with pastel pink and lavender accents match the wallpaper; the fetch pane is airy but the terminals share space with GUI apps.
Forest wallpaper with a music player and visualizer bars drawn on the desktop; no framed terminal window is visible.
Two paper-white cards, a fetch and a calendar TUI, share a soft blue and brown palette over a colorful wallpaper. Text is small and low contrast, but it feels like notebook pages.
Two stacked slate windows with pink statusline chips and a white cava; the dark panels contrast sharply with the bright gradient wallpaper, and the type is readable.
Collage of one Nord-grey desktop shown in several states; translucent terminals over the monochrome wallpaper stay cohesive, though text is tiny. Some parts are full GUI apps.
Warm charcoal windows with orange accents match the fiery wallpaper. Fetch with a sprite image, a fire-gradient visualizer and dense code all stay readable.
Smoky dark tiles with muted gruvbox greens sit softly over a misty forest; each tile has one job. Text in the vim and music tiles is small and faint.
A wall of eight borderless-gap dwm tiles (vim, fetch, IRC, ncmpcpp, cava, ranger, monitor) around a central illustration; nord-ish and consistent, though the text is very small.
Nord-style slate windows with thin blue borders float over a wolf wallpaper; consistent palette and good padding, with rainbow cava bars as the only loud color.
The ncmpcpp playlist in cool blue and purple text on a dark slate reads well and matches the muted desktop; the other terminal is a small color-palette shell.
Pure black and grey tiles with a white album cover and white cava bars over a grayscale photo; no color accent at all. Very disciplined, though the vim text is tiny and dim.
Overlapping white windows with thin gray borders over a pale skyscraper photo: shell, Vim, IRC and a roguelike. Strictly grayscale and airy; thin text keeps contrast reasonable.
Three workspaces of full-height terminals beside Anki and a PDF reader; consistent dark slate with readable syntax colors, but the terminals are just one part of a study setup.
Three dark glass windows over a misty forest, all in Manjaro green; large type and padding read well, and the layout feels balanced.
No terminal visible: abstract wallpaper with a tiny launcher, workspace and clock strip.
Full-screen translucent vim shows the pywal-tinted painting through it; text is small and the artwork competes with the code, but the colors match the wallpaper perfectly.
Translucent windows pick up the red-blue wallpaper nicely, but dense config text over a busy gradient is hard to read. The pink prompt chip matches the fetch logo.
One small Konsole window with a fetch block, overshadowed by the file manager, weather widget and launcher. Clean and readable but not the focus.
Three freely placed windows around a bold polygon wallpaper, each a different job. Neon pink and orange text on near-black stays readable and matches the art.
A tall navy nvim window with a thin teal border beside a browser on a rocky blue wallpaper; large font, wide margins and muted syntax colors make it easy to read.
Three even tiles with wide gaps over a soft wallpaper; muted syntax colors, generous padding and a right-aligned path in the prompt make it calm and very readable.
Restrained blue-grey dashboard of small borderless tiles, each with one job; very tidy and cohesive, with pale text that is faint at small sizes.
Collage of an anime night wallpaper with dark terminals in cool blue and pink highlights; a wide neovim split, fetch, ranger and a music TUI all share a calm palette.
Only the nnn file list is a terminal; the large code window is GUI Emacs. Dracula purples match the dusk wallpaper, but the terminal is a small part of the shot.
Light grey terminals with red accents stand out against the crimson wallpaper, readable with a matching color strip; the large character art draws focus away from them.
Gruvbox yellow-on-charcoal windows tiled beside a start-page browser; a full-height neovim and ranger with an image preview are crisp and legible, with one amber accent.
A single small dark fetch window centered on a bright purple wallpaper; clean contrast but tiny text, and the terminal is not the star of the shot.
Floating alacritty windows (banner and shell, cava) over a sunset wallpaper with a Dracula-style prompt; fits together nicely, but the translucent Emacs behind and widgets crowd the layout.
Frosted pale terminals with pywal-matched dusty pink and mauve tones float over a sunrise mountain photo; soft and cohesive, but the light text on pale glass is faint.
Only a tiny dark fetch window in an overview thumbnail; the rest is a bright blue settings panel and wallpapers, so the terminal barely registers.
Three tmux-wrapped windows (htop, fetch, pipes) in one rust-orange on brown palette that matches the wallpaper; tmux status bars frame each; htop text is small but readable.
Floating gruvbox windows (fetch, ranger with preview, ytop) over a warm night wallpaper; yellow borders and highlights match the lamp glow, text is crisp against dark panels.
Slate-blue tiles with lilac text match the gradient wallpaper, and a big pixel-art banner in the editor is a nice touch; tall editor tile is mostly empty config text.
Teal-on-black htop and a screenfetch block match the pale seaglass wallpaper; both are small and dense, so the text is hard to read at this size.
Dark rounded translucent windows pull their red and coral palette straight from the sunset; the fetch color swatches and peach cava bar tie it together. Good padding and rounded borders.
Four soft-shadowed charcoal windows on grey with red as the only colour; neat gaps and padding, an overlapping fetch breaks the grid.
A disciplined Gruvbox dashboard with editor, monitor, visualizer and cowsay tiles; one warm palette, aligned frames and a pixel-art wallpaper tie it together.
Slate panels with pink and blue accents echo the retro-computer wallpaper. Music, fetch and three cava windows are packed edge to edge, cohesive and legible.
Many TUI windows (fetch, vim, ytop, ranger, ncmpcpp, visualizer) in one magenta-and-teal scheme over a sunset wallpaper; rich and consistent, with some dim translucent text.
Flat charcoal windows with thin cream borders and drop shadows share one palette with the bar and browser; the border is the whole identity, text stays readable with roomy padding.
Collage of a themed login screen and a wall of thin-bordered cyan-on-purple tiles (ranger, fetch, cava, editors, clock); strong cyberpunk palette, but tiles are crowded and text tiny.
One calm dark vim window with rounded corners centred over a vivid sunset; padding is generous and syntax colors are soft, so it reads clearly against the busy picture.
Borderless slate tiles with a lavender cava and a pixel-art picture form a tidy widget-like dashboard; one palette and even spacing, though the text is tiny.
A painted dusk lake wallpaper with a top bar only; no terminal visible.
A small charcoal fetch card with orange labels sits on a lavender desktop next to a big picture. Cute and neat, but the terminal is secondary and tiny.
Only a VS Code window with the top bar is visible; no terminal appears despite the iTerm2 tag.
Near-black windows with a single green accent float over a grey mountain; the editor syntax colors are bright and the padding is generous. Contrast against the pale wallpaper is strong.
Strict dark navy with one mint-green accent on tmux title bars, highlights and the palette strip; very disciplined. Terminals sit in small floating boxes beside a browser and a PDF viewer.
Dark charcoal tiles with orange text echo the sunset wallpaper; ASCII cat art, a big fetch and ytop give variety while the single accent color keeps it disciplined.
Slate-blue windows with pink prompt arrows and a swatch strip fit the soft anime wallpapers. Small windows next to a file manager, so the terminal is a minor part.
Many translucent terminals (music, flashcards, feeds, home status, vim, mail) float over a fern wallpaper; the dark-green glass and warm text feel unified, though crowded in places.
Two stacked editor windows with purple status lines match the magenta geometric theme. Terminals are only one part of a collage dominated by widgets.
Two small dark windows with a pfetch block and colorful pixel ghosts add personality on a neon wallpaper; the Doom Emacs and document panels are GUI and not counted.
Only a side panel over a keyboard wallpaper; no terminal window is visible.
One dark brown translucent terminal with orange highlights that match the orange wallpaper; fetch plus command output is readable, small padding and tiny text.
Dark and light theme variants of one desktop; the fetch windows with big logos or banners follow the theme well, but the terminals are small next to the file manager and menus.
Translucent terminals with inline images (covers, video preview) over bright anime art, mixed with manga and launcher screens. Fun and cohesive, but text is small and low-contrast.
Strict green on black: fetch, falling matrix text and htop tiled edge to edge, with the wallpaper ghosting through. Big type and a single accent make it very readable.
Gruvbox vim, a teal-bordered fetch and a cmus panel overlap a faded autumn wallpaper; generous padding and a pixel title banner, but overlapped windows clip some text.
Deep purple terminals with hot pink highlights follow the wallpaper closely (pywal-style); the full-screen file manager with image preview is the strongest part.
Collage whose best part is a tiled fetch, cava, cmatrix, htop and pipes wall over a bright desk photo; the small dark tiles pop but are tiny and the other parts are GUI.
A rare light-grey terminal with teal and green fetch headings next to a light Emacs window over an underwater painting; clear and calm, but the GUI views and wallpaper share the stage.
Gray frosted windows with thin borders over an icy mountain painting; ranger, fetch and a large blurred-glass Neovim. Cohesive cool palette, though the blurred editor text is faint.
Opaque navy windows with lavender borders float over a red forest; the dark panels give strong contrast and the palette stays tight. Cava, ranger and vim fill the space well.
Frosted translucent panes let the forest show through while the text stays readable; the tall vim window gives a strong focal block next to the small fetch box.
No terminal visible: a macOS-style gradient wallpaper with a top bar and a widget panel (network, sound, music controls).
Translucent cyan-lit glass windows with fetch, htop, cmatrix and a file manager match the teal sci-fi wallpaper; a fine hacker look, though text over the busy art loses some contrast.
One big window split into six panes (fetch, giant clock, music, cava, ranger) in slate grey with teal and salmon accents. Dense but well balanced, with a restrained palette.
A slate editor with a teal status line sits beside a light PDF viewer over a mountain wallpaper; clear LaTeX highlighting, a readable font and wide padding, so it works as a study setup.
Deep navy iTerm and nvim with a nerd tree and tagbar, tmux status on top, cyan accents that echo the teal landscape wallpaper. The fullscreen nvim is dense but readable.
Tall collage of one tiled desktop in several states: a full-width editor, then music, shell and mixer terminals stacked beside a PDF. Flat Nord-like palette with a clear hierarchy.
Dark teal-black xterm windows that sit well on the blue-green wallpaper; a compact fetch block and a roomy Vim pane with soft, low-key code colors beside a PDF viewer.
Four small black windows (fetch, music downloader, cava, color swatches) with drop shadows over the colorful gradient wallpaper; crisp contrast, each window has one job.
Dark and light variants of one theme with matching music, fetch and cover-art windows plus a file manager and login screen. Soft pastel accents stay consistent; the terminal text is tiny.
One small dark fetch terminal among a file manager, emulator and music player; the sharp bright fetch colors read well on black, but it is just one of many windows.
Small dark windows with salmon-pink title bars floating over a rose photo: fetch, lyrics in an editor and cava. Soft pink accent matches the flowers; the rest of the shot is GUI apps.
A tiled wall of seven neon-bordered terminals (fetch, vim, matrix, pipes, htop, man) in cyan and pink; every tile has a job and gaps are even. Photographed screen, so a little glare.
A photo of a console handheld and a monitor running htop and ufetch in green on black; the plain tty look is the point, but the photo is blurry and angled.
Three black boxes with thin cyan and lavender text over a bright gradient give strong contrast and a clear hierarchy; the launcher and browser views make the terminals only part of the shot.
Frosted blue-navy windows let the night street wallpaper through; the soft blue text matches the scene. The big figlet banners fill a window nicely and the editor stays readable.
Nord slate vim with a file tree sits comfortably over misty forest; matches the glava and polybar colors. The git terminal is small and its text hard to read.
Completely black image; nothing to see.
Rounded dark-brown windows on a cream wallpaper with olive and yellow text; generous padding, matching gaps and a cute mascot make it soft and very readable.
Four near-black rounded windows floating over a flat pink wallpaper; strong contrast and consistent rounded frames, with text kept short and the colors pulled from the artwork.
